enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wet towel. Wipe face. Rinse towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat eggs. Eat bread. Drink milk. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Put wallet in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, treating patients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to therapy room. Check schedule. Greet patient. Review patient chart. Assist patient with exercises. Demonstrate stretches. Apply heat pack. Monitor patient. Document progress. Walk patient to waiting area. Call next patient. Review chart. Assist with exercises. Demonstrate exercise. Apply cold pack. Monitor patient. Document progress. Clean equipment. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Walk back to therapy room. See more patients. Document notes. Schedule appointments. Clean therapy room. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off stove. Put food on plate.
Walk to table. Sit down. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll through social media. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Pick up remote. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer to check emails or read
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Wait for computer to start. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to email. Close email program. Open web browser. Read news articles. Close web browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading or listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Play music. Put down phone. Close eyes. Listen to music.
Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
